closed_populations.status: CLOSED - already consumed, descriptive evidence only
NOT SCORED - no usable Xception face score
EXCLUDE_OVERLAP - perceptually identical (dHash 0) to a Phase-4A LOCKED test file; deliberately kept out of every Phase-4B split

development_pools.description: P4B DEV/VAL rows that carry a usable Xception face score and an AASIST score; this is exactly the 25-sample population the frozen V2 rank reference and the Day-5/Day-6 OOF were built on.
D7 samples with evidence_status == SUFFICIENT; the only D7 tier that Day-9/10/11 used for selection.

leakage_controls: Day-6 locked 8 excluded from every fit/selection/threshold step
D7 visual-unavailable 8 and P4B visual-unavailable 3 not scored
frozen 25-sample rank reference read through day6_candidate only
imputation median, scaler, model and threshold all fitted inside the training fold
no training-set accuracy computed or reported
label-proxy columns (subtype, source_group, source, acquisition, exposure_tier, partition, filename, path, md5) excluded from every feature set; P4B source_group is 100% label-pure
no sample appears in two development pools (disjoint id namespaces, zero shared md5)

selection.rule: primary scheme only, judged on BOTH development populations; P4B_DEV25 accuracy>=0.80 AND P4B_DEV25 FAKE recall>=0.70 AND D7_DEV16 accuracy >= frozen V2 on D7 AND P4B_DEV25 accuracy >= frozen V2 on P4B AND on both pools REAL specificity>0 AND predicted-FAKE rate<0.95 AND degenerate-fold fraction<=0.20 AND not exploratory
selection.rule_note: POOLED41_SENSITIVITY and LR_EXT_C01 are excluded from the headline claim by construction
selection.reached_80_percent_definition: true only if a candidate passed every pre-declared admissibility check; the largest single accuracy printed anywhere in this experiment is NOT sufficient
selection.reason: no learned candidate satisfied every pre-declared admissibility check on BOTH development populations; the strongest honestly-evaluated learned candidate is reported for transparency and NOTHING is selected for implementation
